build_shortcut_model: build a ShortCut model with configurable self_consistency_prob and shortcut_loss_weight for 3D object generation
generate_d_step_sizes: generate binary-time shortcut step sizes d for a batch of input tensors using _generate_d
compute_self_consistency_target: compute the self-consistency target with CFG blending for shortcut model training samples
loss_mixed_objective: compute the mixed flow matching and self-consistency loss for training the shortcut model
generate_iter_samples: generate 3D object samples iteratively using the shortcut model ODE solver with conditionals
